mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blog_rss_subscription WHERE user_id = #{user} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM blog_rss_subscription WHERE subscription_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_rss_subscription SET status = 2, verified_at = NULL, unsubscribe_time = COALESCE(unsubscribe_time, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE user_id = #{user} AND NOT (CAST(email AS BINARY) <=> CAST(#{email,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS BINARY)) AND (status <> 2 OR verified_at IS NOT NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM blog_rss_subscription s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id AND u.status = 1 AND s.email = LOWER(TRIM(u.email)) WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND s.subscription_id > #{after} ORDER BY s.subscription_id LIMIT 100
